note: Risk tiers for changes and approvals. Defaults to adapt: the timings are targets for an organization to set, not guarantees. Every approval-gated stage has exactly one tier in stage_tiers.

tiers.name: Informational
criteria: Documents, analysis or code on a branch

tiers.name: Low
criteria: Reversible change in a non-production environment
No customer data or access change

tiers.name: Moderate
criteria: Reaches production or accepts delivery risk but is reversible and tested
No change to access, secrets, data deletion or security controls
tiers.approval: named owner of the affected service or decision
tiers.evidence: test evidence for the exact build

tiers.name: High
criteria: Changes production data, schema, access, secrets, network policy or a security control
Affects many customers if it fails
tiers.approval: named accountable human plus an independent verifier
tiers.evidence: independently verified evidence for the exact artifact

tiers.name: Critical
criteria: Active attack testing, full failover or product retirement
Disables a security control or accepts residual risk for the organization
tiers.approval: named executive risk owner plus the security or compliance owner
tiers.evidence: independently verified evidence and a written risk acceptance
tiers.rollback: rehearsed, or a written statement that none is possible and why
